# Roadmap — lege-ecosystem

Live milestones in `after` order, then standing tracks. Acceptance verdicts are computed
from evidence under the descendant-commit rule (D-016).

## Milestones

### Business-grade PDF OCR CLI

`completed` · `@lege-ecosystem.milestone.business-pdf-ocr-cli/2`

Deliver the approved local, resumable, backend-neutral PDF OCR pipeline and its staged searchable and structured outputs.

> **Note:** Implement the approved dedicated OCR plan in production-sized milestones, preserving raw OCR evidence and existing Lege product compatibility. As of 2026-09-08 all three work items are completed and four of the five acceptance commands pass on Linux at HEAD 823d46dd. The one failing check is core-cli, and it is a test defect rather than a product gap: see lege-ecosystem.work.document-ocr-cli-native-text-backend-init for what has to be decided.
